#Blueface Says Just Because A Female Made $1 MILLION In A Year Doesn’t Mean She’s Rich 🤔👀

📸 @ab.ltdd 

Blueface, Born Johnathan Jamall Porter On January 20, 1997, Is A Los Angeles Rapper And Internet Personality Who Rose To Fame In 2018 With His Viral Hit “Respect My Cryppin’.” Known For His Unique Offbeat Flow, Distinctive Voice, And West Coast Sound, Blueface Became A Household Name Following The Success Of His Breakout Single “Thotiana,” Which Later Featured Remixes With Cardi B And YG.

Beyond Music, Blueface Has Remained A Major Topic On Social Media Through His Streaming Career, Viral Moments, And Highly Publicized Relationships With Chrisean Rock And Jaidyn Alexis. His Personal Life, Family, And Online Antics Continue To Generate Attention, Keeping Him One Of The Most Talked-About Personalities In The West Coast Entertainment Scene.
